en.title: SIPEC
en.summary: Built the institutional surveys and forms platform, with a page-based editor and traceable response collection.
en.context: Institutional forms, access control and integrity between frontend and backend.
en.role: Full stack development with generated OpenAPI/GraphQL types and clients, plus shared schemas.
en.result: Moved from several repositories to a monorepo, which put an end to contract drift between frontend and backend.

ptBR.title: SIPEC
ptBR.summary: Construí a plataforma institucional de formulários, com editor baseado em páginas e coleta rastreável de respostas.
ptBR.context: Formulários institucionais, controle de acesso e integridade entre frontend e backend.
ptBR.role: Desenvolvimento full stack com tipos e clientes gerados a partir de OpenAPI e GraphQL.
ptBR.result: Saiu de múltiplos repositórios para um monorepo, o que acabou com a divergência de contratos entre frontend e backend.
